semantics.supported_positive: At least three comparable task opportunities and rescue rate at least 0.50; eligible for advisory recommendation at that resolution.
semantics.supported_negative: At least three comparable task opportunities with rescue rate below 0.50; may support advisory avoidance, never a positive recommendation.
semantics.observed: At least one comparable opportunity without sufficient support for a positive or negative policy claim.
semantics.insufficient: No comparable valid evidence at the resolution.
semantics.abstain: No available intervention has supported-positive evidence at any permitted resolution.
semantics.broader_backoff: Broader evidence may be consulted only when the more-specific resolution lacks supported-positive evidence; more-specific evidence remains in the advisory record.

failure_class_mapping: The deterministic mapping registered in local_harness/capability_cards.py; unknown check IDs remain unclassified:<check_id>.
